journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.title_en: Rationally Inattentive Statistical Discrimination: Arrow Meets Phelps
articles.title_cn: 理性疏忽的统计歧视：阿罗遇见费尔普斯
articles.abstract_en: When information acquisition is costly but flexible, a principal may rationally acquire information that favors one group over another. The former group faces incentives to invest in becoming productive, while the latter is discouraged from such investments. In turn, the principal largely overlooks the productivity differences between groups and primarily promotes the invested group, unless the underinvested group surprises him with a genuinely outstanding outcome. We show that, when attention costs are intermediate, investment costs are low, and investments are likely to succeed, the discriminatory equilibrium is the most preferred by the principal, despite all groups being ex-ante identical. Our results inform the discussion of affirmative action, implicit bias, and occupational segregation and stereotypes.
articles.abstract_cn: 当信息获取成本高昂但灵活时，委托人可能理性地获取偏向某一群体的信息。前一个群体面临投资以提高生产率的激励，而后一个群体则被此类投资所抑制。反过来，委托人很大程度上忽视了群体间的生产率差异，主要提拔投资群体，除非投资不足的群体以真正出色的表现让他感到意外。我们表明，当注意力成本处于中等水平、投资成本较低且投资很可能成功时，尽管所有群体事前相同，歧视性均衡是委托人最偏好的。我们的结果对平权行动、隐性偏见以及职业隔离和刻板印象的讨论有所启示。

articles.title_en: Chain Restaurant Calorie Posting Laws, Obesity, and Consumer Welfare
articles.title_cn: 连锁餐厅卡路里标注法律、肥胖与消费者福利
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether and why laws requiring chain restaurants to post calories on menus and menu boards work. We develop a model of calories consumed that highlights multiple potential channels through which these laws influence choice and that outlines an empirical strategy to disentangle these alternatives. We test the predictions of our model using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System on body mass index and consumer well-being, as well as our own surveys on how the law influences where people eat and how randomized exposure to calorie information affects feelings toward menu items. Viewed in its totality, our results are consistent with an economic model in which calorie labels influence consumers both by providing salient information and by imposing a welfare-reducing moral cost (or feelings of guilt) on unhealthy eating.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了要求连锁餐厅在菜单和菜单板上标注卡路里的法律是否有效以及为何有效。我们构建了一个卡路里消费模型，突出了这些法律影响选择的多个潜在渠道，并概述了一种实证策略来区分这些替代解释。我们使用行为风险因素监测系统中关于身体质量指数和消费者福祉的数据，以及我们自己的关于法律如何影响人们就餐地点和随机暴露于卡路里信息如何影响对菜单项感受的调查，来检验模型的预测。总体来看，我们的结果与一个经济模型一致，在该模型中，卡路里标签既通过提供显著信息影响消费者，也通过对不健康饮食施加降低福利的道德成本（或内疚感）来影响消费者。

articles.title_en: The Transmission of Negative Nominal Interest Rates in Finland
articles.title_cn: 芬兰负名义利率的传导
articles.abstract_en: Despite the implementation of negative nominal interest rates by several advanced economies in the last decade, there is still much we do not know about the effectiveness of this instrument. In this paper, we analyze the pass-through of the European Central Bank’s changes in the deposit facility rate to mortgage rates in Finland between 2005 and 2020. We use monthly data and three different empirical methodologies: event studies, high-frequency identification, and exposure-measure regressions. We provide robust evidence that there continues to be pass-through of a cut in the policy rate to mortgage rates even when the policy rate is in negative territory, but that this pass-through is smaller than when the policy rate is in positive territory.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管在过去十年中，多个发达经济体实施了负名义利率，但我们对这一工具的有效性仍知之甚少。在本文中，我们分析了2005年至2020年间欧洲央行存款便利利率变动对芬兰抵押贷款利率的传导。我们使用月度数据并采用三种不同的实证方法：事件研究、高频识别和暴露度量回归。我们提供了稳健的证据表明，即使政策利率处于负值区域，政策利率下调对抵押贷款利率的传导仍然存在，但这种传导小于政策利率处于正值区域时的传导。

articles.title_en: Rethinking the Informal Economy and the Hugo Effect
articles.title_cn: 重新思考非正规经济与雨果效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper offers a new approach to measuring the size of the informal economy based on VAT data for the European Union. Although data intensive, our evading value added duty economy (EVADE) measure is simpler and more transparent than existing measures. EVADE also shows more variation across countries of Europe than earlier measures, including higher informality in Greece, Italy, and Spain, for example. Moreover, we find considerably higher variation within countries across time; in a cross-country time series regression, controlling for tax rates, we confirm that the informal economy grows significantly in recessions and decreases in booms, which we term the “Hugo effect”.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于欧盟的增值税数据，提出了一种衡量非正规经济规模的新方法。尽管数据密集，我们的逃避增值税经济（EVADE）衡量指标比现有指标更简单、更透明。EVADE还显示出欧洲各国之间的差异比早期指标更大，例如，希腊、意大利和西班牙的非正规性更高。此外，我们发现各国在不同时间内的差异显著更大；在跨国时间序列回归中，控制税率后，我们确认非正规经济在经济衰退时期显著增长，在经济繁荣时期减少，我们称之为“雨果效应”。

articles.title_en: Global Profit Shifting of Multinational Companies: Evidence from Country-by-Country Reporting Micro Data
articles.title_cn: 跨国公司的全球利润转移：基于国别报告微观数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use micro data from country-by-country reports of more than 3,600 multinational companies to analyze global profit shifting to avoid taxes. Unlike other data sets, country-by-country reports provide detailed information about the global economic activities of multinational companies, including those in tax haven countries. We find that these companies reduce their tax burden by €39 billion per year by shifting profits to low-tax countries. Extrapolating our results to the universe of large multinational enterprises indicates a global loss in corporate tax revenues of €162 billion per year (12% of their overall tax payments). We show that taking into account non-linearities in profit shifting and subsidiaries reporting zero profits is key for accurately estimating profit shifting.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用超过3,600家跨国公司的国别报告微观数据来分析为避税而进行的全球利润转移。与其他数据集不同，国别报告提供了跨国公司全球经济活动的详细信息，包括在避税天堂国家的活动。我们发现，这些公司通过将利润转移到低税国家，每年减少税负39亿欧元。将我们的结果外推到所有大型跨国企业，表明全球企业所得税收入每年损失162亿欧元（占其总税收支付的12%）。我们表明，考虑利润转移中的非线性和报告零利润的子公司对于准确估计利润转移至关重要。

articles.title_en: Personality Traits and Cognitive Ability in Political Selection
articles.title_cn: 政治选择中的人格特质和认知能力
articles.abstract_en: A vast scholarship questions whether voters are sufficiently informed to act in their best interest at the polling booth, which may also have implications for the quality of political representation. In this study, we examine cognitive and non-cognitive ability tests conducted on (male) military conscripts by the Finnish Defense Forces and compare local and national election candidates nominated by political parties and representatives elected by voters with each other and the general population. We show that non-elected candidates fare better in the tests than the population, on average, and elected politicians demonstrate even higher levels of ability. Local politicians’ cognitive and non-cognitive skills are on par with individuals who work in high-skill occupations or have at least an undergraduate degree, and national politicians are even better. Our findings suggest that, despite the complex decision-making environment inherent in voter-oriented systems, a political class that is more competent, motivated, and honest than the general population emerges. We further discuss the scope for positive political selection of women, show that there is no evident trade-off between politician quality and descriptive representation, and present evidence on the mechanisms for and the policy effects of positive selection.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量学者质疑选民是否有足够的信息在投票站以自己的最佳利益行事，这也可能对政治代表的质量产生影响。在这项研究中，我们研究了芬兰国防军对（男性）军事义务兵进行的认知和非认知能力测试，并将政党提名的地方和全国选举候选人以及选民选出的代表与彼此以及普通民众进行比较。我们发现，平均而言，非民选候选人在测试中的表现比普通民众要好，而民选政治家则表现出更高水平的能力。地方政治家的认知和非认知技能与从事高技能职业或至少拥有本科学位的个人相当，而国家政治家甚至更好。我们的研究结果表明，尽管以选民为导向的制度固有复杂的决策环境，但仍然出现了一个比普通民众更有能力、更有动力、更诚实的政治阶层。我们进一步讨论了女性积极政治选择的范围，表明政治家素质和描述性代表性之间不存在明显的权衡，并提供了积极选择的机制和政策效果的证据。

articles.abstract_en: A large literature shows that people’s valuation of delayed financial rewards violates exponential discounting, exhibiting a hyperbolic pattern: high short-run impatience that strongly decreases in the length of the delay. We test the hypothesis that the hyperbolic pattern in measured discount rates over money reflects mistakes driven by the complexity of evaluating delayed payoffs. We document that hyperbolicity (i) is strongly associated with choice inconsistency and cognitive uncertainty, (ii) increases in overt complexity manipulations, and (iii) arises nearly identically in computationally similar tasks that involve no actual payoff delays. Our results suggest that even if people had exponential discount functions, complexity-driven mistakes would cause them to make hyperbolic choices. We examine which experimental techniques to estimate present bias are (not) confounded by information-processing constraints.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量文献表明，人们对延迟经济回报的估值违背了指数贴现，表现出双曲线模式：短期高度不耐烦，且不耐烦程度随延迟时长显著下降。我们检验了一个假设，即测量到的货币贴现率中的双曲线模式反映了由评估延迟回报的复杂性所导致的错误。我们记录了双曲线性（i）与选择不一致性和认知不确定性密切相关，（ii）在显性复杂性操纵下增加，以及（iii）在涉及无实际支付延迟的计算相似任务中几乎相同地出现。我们的结果表明，即使人们具有指数贴现函数，复杂性驱动的错误也会导致他们做出双曲线选择。我们考察了哪些估计当前偏差的实验技术（不）受信息处理约束的混淆影响。

articles.title_en: Mandated Sick Pay: Coverage, Utilization, and Crowding-in
articles.title_cn: 强制病假工资：覆盖率、使用情况与挤入效应
articles.abstract_en: Using the National Compensation Survey from 2009 to 2022 and difference-in-differences methods, we find that state-level sick pay mandates are effective in broadening access to paid sick leave for U.S. workers. Increases in sick pay coverage reach 30 percentage points from a 63% baseline 5 years post-mandate. Mandates have more bite in jobs with low pre-mandate coverage. Further, mandates reduce inequality in access to paid sick leave substantially, both across and within firms. COVID-19 reinforced existing upward trends in coverage and take-up. Five years post mandate, sick leave use has linearly increased to 2.4 days per year for marginal jobs. Finally, we find crowding-in of non-mandated benefits, which we label “job upscaling” by firms to differentiate jobs and attract labor.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用2009年至2022年的全国薪酬调查数据以及双重差分方法，我们发现州级病假工资强制规定有效扩大了美国工人获得带薪病假的机会。在强制规定实施5年后，病假工资覆盖率从63%的基线水平上升了30个百分点。强制规定在实施前覆盖率较低的工作中影响更为显著。此外，强制规定显著减少了获得带薪病假的差距，无论是在不同企业之间还是企业内部。COVID-19强化了覆盖率和使用率的现有上升趋势。在强制规定实施五年后，边缘工作的病假使用量线性增加至每年2.4天。最后，我们发现了非强制福利的挤入效应，我们将其称为企业的“工作升级”，以区分工作岗位并吸引劳动力。

articles.title_en: Cost and Benefits of Climate Change Adaptation Policies: Evidence from an RCT and Extreme Flooding in Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 气候变化适应政策的成本与收益：来自巴基斯坦随机对照试验和极端洪水的证据
articles.abstract_en: A significant component of the cost of climate change is the investment required for adaptation programs. Effective adaptation strategies are becoming essential for managing the negative economic impacts of climate change. In this study, we estimate climate change damage costs that incorporate adaptation costs and benefits under different environmental scenarios. Over a 3-year period, we tracked households in rural Sindh, some of which experienced extreme monsoon flooding in 2016. We present how targeted climate adaptation measures can be effective in mitigating adverse climate effects and fostering resilience. Compared to a randomly selected control group, communities participating in a humanitarian aid preparedness program demonstrated significant improvements in food security and health outcomes after experiencing the negative weather shock. A cost-benefit analysis shows that the adaptation investments pay for themselves after a short period of time and have the potential to considerably reduce the social costs of carbon if a longer time horizon is considered. This paper contributes to the climate change literature by demonstrating how estimates from field experiments can be used to update the costs of climate change projections, while also highlighting the limitations of this approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化成本的一个重要组成部分是适应项目所需的投资。有效的适应策略对于管理气候变化的负面经济影响正变得至关重要。在本研究中，我们估算了在不同环境情景下包含适应成本和收益的气候变化损害成本。在3年的时间里，我们追踪了信德省农村的家庭，其中一些家庭在2016年经历了极端季风洪水。我们展示了有针对性的气候适应措施如何有效减轻不利气候影响并增强韧性。与随机选择的对照组相比，参与人道主义援助备灾计划的社区在经历负面天气冲击后，在粮食安全和健康结果方面表现出显著改善。成本效益分析表明，适应投资在短时间内即可收回成本，并且如果考虑更长的时间范围，有可能大幅减少碳的社会成本。本文通过展示如何利用实地实验的估计来更新气候变化预测的成本，为气候变化文献做出贡献，同时也强调了这种方法的局限性。

articles.title_en: Values as Luxury Goods and Political Behavior
articles.title_cn: 价值观作为奢侈品与政治行为
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by novel survey evidence, we develop a theory of political behavior in which the relative weight voters place on values rather than material considerations increases in income. The model unifies several stylized facts about US politics and makes new predictions. The luxury goods idea implies—and two datasets confirm—that rich moral liberals are considerably more likely to vote against their economic interests than poor moral conservatives, cautioning against the common narrative that the working class is particularly politically motivated by values. For sufficiently morally liberal voters, increased income can even reduce the likelihood of voting for Republicans. Rich liberals’ and poor conservatives’ asymmetric priorities also explain why Democrats are internally more heterogeneous than Republicans, and why income and voting Republican are positively correlated across voters but negatively across states. Finally, we interpret the secular partisan realignment of rich moral liberals and poor moral conservatives through our model.
articles.abstract_cn: 受新颖调查证据的启发，我们发展了一种政治行为理论，其中选民对价值观而非物质考虑的相对重视程度随收入增加而提高。该模型统一了关于美国政治的若干典型化事实并做出了新的预测。奢侈品观念意味着——并且两个数据集证实——富裕的道德自由主义者比贫穷的道德保守主义者更有可能违背其经济利益投票，这警示了关于工人阶级特别受价值观政治动机驱动的常见叙述。对于足够道德自由主义的选民，收入的增加甚至可能降低投票给共和党的可能性。富裕自由主义者与贫穷保守主义者的不对称优先事项也解释了为什么民主党内部比共和党更加异质，以及为什么收入与投票给共和党在选民层面正相关但在州层面负相关。最后，我们通过我们的模型解释了富裕道德自由主义者和贫穷道德保守主义者的长期党派重组。
